Chances are, if you're a US citizen then you are done voting for the moment. But there are some districts where elections are yet to be held or runoff elections are required to seal the deal.

Here's a brief NPR article about it:

http://www.npr.org/blogs/itsallpolitics/2014/11/13/363842770/in-some-miderm-races-theres-no-winning-yet

How to check: Go to your state's website, and explore. There will be a registrar of voters or similar office responsible for providing information. Google may also help if you know there's a runoff election but you don't know when it is.

If you didn't vote, and there is a runoff election, then your district needs you to break the tie!
PSA: Check if elections are really over for your district

It flashed successfully last night and I played with it a while.

First thing I noticed is at the setup screen, it said my phone was a tablet. :/ But that wasn't really a problem, cause the setup continued as normal.

The phone went to the home screen, and I noticed it started getting hot near the camera, like REALLY hot. And it wasn't just for a brief moment, it stayed hot the whole time. It kind of bothered me, cause one of my batteries already almost exploded.

Anyway, the ROM is pretty good for an Alpha. It's slows down a lot sometimes, but is pretty smooth overall, and a lot of the things work. There are some FC's here and there, but it's expected.

There are some things that don't work at all, like phone, network, NFC, sound, the IR Blaster, etc.

At least WIFI works, so you'll be able to connect to the Internet.

I won't really recommend using this ROM because of the above mentioned things that don't function and the fact that it causes the phone to get extremely hot.

I would recommend it however if you only want to use it to check out Lollipop for a few minutes or so.

Also, I'm not sure if it's normal or because of the tablet issue, but the notification icons are pretty small.

Thanks for the follow up. It sounds like things need a lot more polishing. I'll stick with my "old" OS until Samsung pushes an update. Even then, I'll wait for a while to see if people discover any new bugs before updating.
